programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Tearful Promise! The Kidnapped Momonosuke!
programme.desc: Swept away by Kanjuro, Momonosuke remembers his father, tries to rise above his fear, and speak to his allies. Luffy and the others start heading for Onigashima, but Kaido's army gets in their way again with a formidable weapon.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A New Member! 'First Son of the Sea' Jimbei!
programme.desc: Luffy and the rest of the Straw Hat crew are excited to see Jimbei again and welcome him as a new member. Meanwhile, Law and the Akazaya members strategize on how to enter Onigashima and attack Kaido.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Kaido’s Trump Card! The Tobi Roppo Appear!
programme.desc: To Law and the others' surprise, Luffy and the rest of the Straw Hats attack the giant torii gate in front of Onigashima. Meanwhile, Kaido and Orochi are having a big banquet on the island where Kaido's formidable subordinates are also called in.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Samurai Warriors’ Earnestness! The Straw Hats Land at Onigashima!
programme.desc: The Straw Hats and the samurai warriors finally reach Onigashima! Before they set out for the castle as they planned, the samurai warriors use surprising but determined tactics to cut off their retreat which leave the Straw Hats in shock.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Luffy Goes Out of Control?! Sneaking into Kaido’s Banquet!
programme.desc: Eustass Kid and his clan start heading for Kaido's castle head on waving Luffy off. Luffy and Zoro go after them to stop them from causing trouble, but they happen to step into Kaido's banquet.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Thinking of Otama! Luffy’s Furious Strike!
programme.desc: Luffy and Zoro each witness Kaido's subordinates waste food at the banquet and make fun of the poor people in the Land of Wano. Thinking of Otama, a small girl who liked red-bean soup so much, both Luffy and Zoro become infuriated and create turmoil.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Fighting Music! An Ability That Harms Luffy!
programme.desc: After making a scene at the Golden Festival, Luffy and Zoro try to get away, but Queen announces his subordinates that anyone who catches them will be rewarded with a position in the Tobi Roppo.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: His Dream Broken?! The Trap That Lures Sanji!
programme.desc: Haccha, a supergiant Number, joins in and the pursuit of Luffy and the others becomes even more intense!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Reinforcements Arrive! The Commander of the Whitebeard Pirates!
programme.desc: Luffy, Law, Kin'emon, and all the others are trying to infiltrate Kaido's castle from all sides. Meanwhile, Big Mom's children are climbing up the waterfall towards Onigashima, but this time, Marco the Phoenix appears from nowhere and stands in their way!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Pact Between Men! The Fierce Fighting of Brachio Tank!
programme.desc: The furious Big Mom chases Brachio Tank driven by Chopper and Usopp, but they bravely fight back!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Thunder Bagua! Here Comes Kaido’s Son!
programme.desc: Luffy runs into Ulti and Page One, members of the Tobi Roppo from the Animal Kingdom Pirates. Hearing that he aims to become the King of the Pirates, the brother and sister duo become infuriated and turn themselves into massive beasts.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Enemy or Ally? Luffy and Yamato!
programme.desc: Evading Ulti and Page One, strong members of the Tobi Roppo, Luffy tries to find out what Kaido's son Yamato's motive is. However, the two get in a fight. Taking Luffy's punishing attacks, Yamato remembers someone he fought against in the past.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Desire to be Oden! Yamato’s Dream!
programme.desc: The Akazaya members who were on board Law's Polar Tang finally reach Onigashima and see someone who they didn't expect. Kaido's son Yamato starts telling his story to Luffy, shares his passion, and reveals what's behind his mask!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Explosive?! The Handcuffs that Shackle Yamato’s Freedom!
programme.desc: At the back entrance of Onigashima, the Akazaya members try to get inside the gate, but they're blocked by their former colleague Kanjuro.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Akazaya Face-off! Kikunojo vs. Kanjuro!
programme.desc: Kaido's plan to obtain the great treasure infuriates Orochi, but his unexpected violent move silences everyone. Meanwhile at the back entrance of Onigashima, Kikunojo squares off against Kanjuro and gets into an emotional fight with her former colleague.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Akazaya members start charging towards Kaido from the back of Onigashima. Meanwhile, at the Performance Floor, Kaido closes in on Momonosuke shivering in terror and asks him the ultimate question which will determine his fate.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Onigashima in Tumult! Luffy’s All-Out War Begins!
programme.desc: The Akazaya members deliver a crushing blow to Kaido. Luffy and Yamato try to back them up, but Ulti stands in their way and Big Mom spots Luffy. Meanwhile, Nami and Carrot free themselves from their enemies and move on to take back Zeus!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Battle Under the Moon! The Berserker, Sulong the Moon Lion!
programme.desc: The Animal Kingdom Pirates gasp with surprise to see thousands of samurai warriors coming into the castle. In his dragon form, Kaido goes outside to fight the Akazaya members under the moon/

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Shinobu tries to rescue the weakened Momonosuke but is found by King and attacked. On the other hand, Nami takes back Zeus from Big Mom and runs away but loses him again and gets chased by Zeus who is ordered to kill to her by Big Mom.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: I’ll Protect You! Yamato Meets Momonosuke!
programme.desc: Franky faces Big Mom with the help of Robin and Jimbei, but the Numbers come interrupting their battle. One of them holds Brachio Tank with Usopp and Chopper inside in his hand. Meanwhile, Yamato finally meets his son Momonosuke.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Overwhelming Strength! The Straw Hats Come Together!
programme.desc: As the Minks struggle with a poor hand against the Gifters, Kin'emon tries to assist them, but Dogstorm and Cat Viper stop him and start fighting for the other Minks!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Risky Invitation! A Plot to Eliminate Queen!
programme.desc: Who's-Who invites Drake and Hawkins to a plot to kill Queen. Meanwhile, the Straw Hats are facing two large monsters that remind them of the Giant who they once struggled to take down. As Luffy charges towards them, someone unexpected comes in to help.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A New Rivalry! Nami and Ulti!
programme.desc: Drake vows to fight alongside Luffy, but Zoro becomes skeptical and challenges him to a fight. Meanwhile, Usopp's practical joke pushes Nami into confronting Ulti, who is infuriated since her brother got attacked.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Heroic Blade! Akazaya vs. Kaido, Again Once More!
programme.desc: Queen uses a new version of the Plague Bullets which will turn the samurai into ogre-like monsters. Meanwhile, the Minks keep pushing the fight against the Gifters and drive Jack into a corner. However, Kaido stands up for his subordinate.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: An Inherited Technique! Unleashing Oden’s Secret Swordplay!
programme.desc: While Luffy is hurrying to the rooftop and Yamato is trying to catch up to Momonosuke to protect him, the Akazaya members finally face off against Kaido.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Power of Ice Oni! A New Version of the Plague Rounds!
programme.desc: Queen, the Lead Performer, blazes away at samurai on the Performance Floor with the special version of the Plague Rounds, which turns them into hideous ogres that corner Zoro and Drake

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: I Won’t Forgive Him! Chopper’s Determination!
programme.desc: King orders his subordinates to go after Momonosuke. Shinobu tries to protect him, but they are cornered by one of the strong Lead Performers from the Animal Kingdom Pirates.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Yamato fights Sasaki and the Animal Kingdom Pirates Armored Division to protect Momonosuke. Meanwhile, Zoro tries to get rid of the Gifters who have turned into Ice Oni, but Queen starts a horrible game which involves the antibody for the virus.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Ulti and Page One of the Tobi Roppo chase Nami and Usopp, after being infuriated by their attack as well as Luffy's declaration of becoming the King of the Pirates. Cornered, Nami gives in and Ulti pushes her to say the unthinkable.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Sasaki’s Onslaught! Armored Division vs. Yamato!
programme.desc: Carrot and Wanda step in to help Marco, who is cornered by Big Mom and Perospero. In the meantime, Yamato fights a fierce battle against the Animal Kingdom Pirates Armored Division led by Sasaki, while protecting Shinobu and Momonosuke.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Eliminate the Ice Oni! Chopper’s Fire Trick!
programme.desc: Zoro and Drake continue to chase Apoo to get the antibody against Ice Oni, while Chopper is trying to figure out how to fight the virus.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: It’s Not Okay! The Spider lures Sanji!
programme.desc: Sanji hears a woman's scream for help and dashes into the room the scream can be heard from. However, it's a trap set up by Black Maria of the Tobi Roppo. Meanwhile, Luffy and Jimbei who are trying to reach the rooftop get help from the unexpected.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Turnaround Move! The Flames of Marco the Phoenix!
programme.desc: While Kaido begins the New Onigashima Project, Marco appears in front of Chopper and the others, who are struggling with Ice Oni. The members of the Tobi Roppo continue to give the Straw Hats a hard time while their former member helps Zoro.

programme.title: Pokemon: Indigo League

programme.title: Pokemon: Indigo League
programme.desc: Realizing that he hasn’t won any Gym badges for a while, Ash signs up for the Pokémon League Admissions Exam, a great chance to prove he’s got what it takes to become a Pokémon Master!

programme.title: Pokemon: Indigo League
programme.desc: Ash and the gang decide to check out a breeding center that they saw on a commercial. However, the center is a cover for a diabolical scheme from Team Rocket members Butch and Cassidy—old rivals of Jessie and James!

programme.title: Pokemon: Adventures in the Orange Islands
programme.desc: Misty and Jessie compete to be Queen of the Princess Festival! Ash and Brock lend Misty their Pokémon for the battle, and Jessie takes a licking despite a surprise Pokémon of her own.

programme.title: Pokemon: Adventures in the Orange Islands
programme.desc: It’s Kids Day, and Ash and friends help some schoolchildren celebrate. Team Rocket spoils the fun by grabbing a kid instead of Pikachu. In a shocking turn of events, Meowth becomes a good guy…or does he?

programme.title: Pokemon: Adventures in the Orange Islands
programme.desc: Our heroes travel to Cinnabar Island, where Ash hopes to win the Volcano Badge. A strange character offers riddles about how to find the Gym, where Ash and Pikachu have a fiery battle with a Pokémon they’ve never seen before!

programme.title: Pokemon: Adventures in the Orange Islands
programme.desc: Ash has finally located the Gym, suspended above a pool of molten lava! This battle for the Volcano Badge can only be won by a strong Fire-type Pokémon, so Ash must rely on his misbehaving Charizard.

programme.title: Pokemon: Adventures in the Orange Islands
programme.desc: While Ash and the gang hurry to catch the last ferry off Cinnabar Island, they get sidetracked by a group of Squirtle, Wartortle, and Blastoise that need assistance!

programme.title: Pokemon: Adventures in the Orange Islands
programme.desc: Misty's Horsea desperately needs exercise, so the gang decides to take it to her sisters' Gym in Cerulean City. There, she learns that her sisters are planning an exciting underwater ballet.

programme.title: Pokemon: Adventures in the Orange Islands
programme.desc: Ash, Brock, and Misty get sidetracked on their way to Viridian City when all of their belongings mysteriously disappear. While searching for their missing things, they find themselves mixed up in a close encounter that’s really out of this world!

programme.title: Pokemon: Adventures in the Orange Islands
programme.desc: Our heroes make their way to Viridian City, where Ash hopes to earn the Earth Badge. They get to the Gym just in time to see his rival, Gary, being defeated by an unknown Pokémon—and Gary insists that it's evil!

programme.title: Pokemon: Adventures in the Orange Islands
programme.desc: On their way back to Pallet Town, our heroes encounter a runaway Mr. Mime. Ash disguises himself as another Mr. Mime so he can get close. When Team Rocket strikes, will they catch the right Mr. Mime?

programme.title: Pokemon: Adventures in the Orange Islands
programme.desc: Our heroes find themselves at a fork in the road and decide to climb a steep and dangerous mountain. Pikachu gets lost, and they must all work together to find it, stay warm, and weather a storm.

programme.title: Pokemon: Adventures in the Orange Islands
programme.desc: On a visit to Professor Oak’s house, Ash runs into Gary, and they talk about the upcoming Pokémon League. Professor Oak says they should learn from each other rather than competing, and that teamwork pays off when Team Rocket attacks!

programme.title: Pokemon: Adventures in the Orange Islands
programme.desc: Ash and his mother take a vacation to Seafoam Island. While he's there, he's looking for the programmer of the Pokédex to learn about the peculiar evolution of SlowPoké. Team Rocket's bumbling brings to light this surprising mystery!

programme.title: Pokemon: Adventures in the Orange Islands
programme.desc: When Ash wipes out during a surfing attempt, Victor rescues him and tells him about Humungadunga, a giant wave that sweeps through every 20 years. Can Ash and Pikachu give Victor the confidence he needs to catch the giant wave?

programme.sub-title: Inside The Mind Of Stephen Hawking

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Living with Space
programme.desc: Astronauts and Cosmonauts train and study for years to work and live aboard the International Space Station. With this wealth of experience and insight behind them what do they think when they return to Earth?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Atmosphere
programme.desc: Our atmosphere is an unbelievably complex machine that protects us from the vacuum of space, shelters us from harmful radiation and allows us and the biosphere to breath; we need to learn much more about it so we can better it.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Flight Status
programme.desc: The next 12 months will see an intense rise in flight tests, demonstration launches and high priority flights. Some are on time others are not. We check the flight status of some of this new hardware and these new capabilities.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Invasion Mars
programme.desc: For over 50 years we have bombarded Mars with our probes and landers. Spying from orbit to map terrain, finding her strengths and weaknesses. The time nearing for the full scale invasion of the planet- when humans walk on Mars and claim it for their own.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Juno, Cassini and Beyond
programme.desc: The Amazing Cassini spacecraft and its sibling lander, Huygens, have now concluded their scientific studies, bringing back years of data. Now, Juno piercing the cloak of Jupiter and her distant relative New Horizons at the edge of the solar system.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Sling Shot
programme.desc: Soviet Luna 3 was the first to use gravity to change course to photograph the dark side of the Moon. NASA Mariner 10 used the technique to swing by Venus to target Mercury. The gravity sling shot maneuver has become a standard for space navigation.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Living Planet
programme.desc: We have been observing Earth for 40 years now, in the last 20 we have focus with intensity on the planet with new technologies and capabilities, we have accumulated a mass of data that is now revealing a complex and ever changing living planet.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Cosmic Collisions

programme.title: Sguardi in camera
programme.desc: Negli anni Quaranta, le cineprese in 8mm seguono i giovani al fronte e ne custodiscono i brevi ritorni: una licenza, un matrimonio in fretta, poi un'altra partenza. Nel 1943 il fascismo cade e il paese si divide, ma si continua a filmare tra bombardamenti, distruzioni e rari momenti di normalità. Fino alla liberazione, quando l'obiettivo ritrova il sorriso sui volti.

Nello speciale, le interviste a "Pinocchio" Andrea Balestri e a "Geppetto" Nino Manfredi.

programme.title: 5000 anni e più. La lunga storia dell'umanità
programme.desc: Grande epopea che racconta le vicende del famigerato guerriero del XII secolo. programme.title: Insieme

Rainbow Ruby
programme.sub-title: Hat Trick // Dancing on the Ice
programme.desc: Everyone is frightened because some visiting birds keep trying to sit on their heads. According to Chirpee, the birds just enjoy sitting on people's heads. Rainbow Ruby designs hats where the birds can comfortably sit without disturbing the villagers. // The village friends were planning to have some fun with the rainbow fish but they're all disappointed to discover that the lake has frozen over.

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.sub-title: When the Moon was Missing // Trouble in a Bubble
programme.desc: The friends are very tired because Mr. Moon hasn't come to sing them their nightly lullaby. Rainbow Ruby uses her magic suitcase to become an Astronaut and flies to space to look for Mr. Moon with her friends. // In Rainbow Village, a super frantic Thunderbell is high up in the air, trapped inside a giant bubble. Thunderbell got trapped in a giant bubble in the middle of a bubble bath. In order to find out a way to bring Thunderbell back to earth, Rainbow Ruby turns into a scientist.

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.desc: Gina accidentally broke Felicia's house, leaving Felicia homeless. Rainbow Ruby uses her magic suitcase to become an architect and builds a house that suits Felicia's demands. // Gina is extremely worried. She needs strawberries for the Rainbow Fruit Ice Cream Festival that's starting soon but the strawberries are all mixed in with other red objects.

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.desc: Thunderbell is sad because he's discovered a new fruit and eaten all of it. Now there's none left and he'll never be able to eat that fruit again. Rainbow Ruby uses her magic suitcase and transforms into a farmer. // Thunderbell has a terrible tummy ache. Rainbow Ruby becomes a Microbiologist to find out why Thunderbell is sick. Rainbow Ruby uses a microscope to find a bacterium inside the cheesecake Thunderbell had but Felicia accidentally casts a spell that makes the bacterium gigantic.

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.desc: Ling Ling takes Rainbow Ruby to Ellie's cabin where she meets mischievous baby stars that fell from the sky. The baby stars were playing together, got separated from their mother and ended up in Rainbow Village. // Kiki is extremely upset because the jewel Prince Frederick gave her as a gift broke. The friends try to glue the broken pieces together but it doesn't work. Rainbow Ruby uses her magic suitcase to become a jewelry designer and tries designing jewelry with the broken pieces.

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.sub-title: Ruby's Ranger Adventure // The Show Must Go On
programme.desc: When Ruby and Choco arrive at the village, they find a very worried looking Ling Ling. Gina, Ellie, and Thunderbell went camping in Rainbow Forest but they saw a monster in the forest, got scared and had to run away. // Ruby is struggling to make a doll with her dad. Ruby and Choco get their suitcase and as Ruby swings her umbrella, there they are, in front of Rainbow fountain. Mayor Ling Ling tells her that today is the day of Princess Kiki's ballet performance.

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.desc: Ruby is looking at shoes that are now too small for her but she is unwilling to throw away. Ling Ling is worried about Thunderbell. His scooter broke so he is not able to carry out his work as a mail carrier. // Gina calls Rainbow Ruby because today is the day to show their appreciation to Mayor Ling Ling. It took a long time for the village friends to prepare an amazing painting for the mayor. Unfortunately, Thunderbell accidentally destroyed the painting while delivering it.

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.sub-title: At Your Service // A Hard Rain
programme.desc: There is a new menu at the restaurant, which is very popular. There is a long line in front of the restaurant but there weren't enough staff members to serve the villagers the food. Rainbow Ruby turns into a waitress using her magic suitcase and serve tables kindly. // Rainbow Village is full of marbles. The marbles that Rainbow Ruby spilled in her room poured down into the village from up above the sky! Rainbow Ruby uses her magic suitcase to transform into a paramedic.

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.desc: Gina, Thunderbell, and Choco try to cheer Jessy up but their efforts are of no use. While talking to Mayor Ling Ling, Rainbow Ruby realizes that today is the day that Jessy first arrived in Rainbow Village! Jessy was upset that her friends forgot such a meaningful day to her. // Ling Ling has caught a bad cold and was sneezing all over the place. Rainbow Ruby uses her magic suitcase and transforms into a doctor and cares for him.

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.sub-title: Behind the Scenes // Paperdoll in Peril
programme.desc: Ling Ling is worried about the play planned for tonight. There are no costumes ready for the villagers so it's hard to figure out which roles they're playing. Rainbow Ruby transforms into a costume designer and designs costumes for her friends. // It is very windy in Rainbow village and Paige, a paper doll, is flying to wherever the wind takes her. She is so light that she is blown away by the wind. Rainbow Ruby uses her magic suitcase to become a fire fighter and rescue Paige.

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.sub-title: Singing in the Rain // Mail Carrier Mayhem
programme.desc: Ling Ling is worried that the villagers are all in low spirits. Ruby thinks of fun games to play but the villagers say that they have already played all of the games too many times. Rainbow Ruby transforms into a singer. // Ling Ling is worried because of the "Secret Present Swapping Party" that Thunderbell is preparing. Thunderbell forgot to send out the invitations. Rainbow Ruby turns into a mail carrier and delivers the invitations.

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.sub-title: Going Golfing // Case of the Stolen Spectacles
programme.desc: Ling Ling tells Rainbow Ruby that a Rainbow Ball Tournament is about to start soon but he is worried because the field is covered with pokey pods. Thunderbell, Ellie, and Gina are trying to pick them up and clear the field but it is not easy since the pokey pods are so spikey. // Ling Ling tells Rainbow Ruby that he lost his glasses. Then Ellie tells her she lost her needles, Gina her hat, and Thunderbell his wheels. Who could have taken away all these things?

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.sub-title: Up in the Air // AdDRESSing the Problem
programme.desc: Ling Ling is waiting for Rainbow Ruby, looking worried. It turns out that Mr. Sloth's best friend Chirpee is depressed. Chirpee wants to fly high but is struggling due to his small wings and lack of means to learn how to fly. // Ling Ling tells Rainbow Ruby that the dress that the paper doll Paige was planning to wear to Kiki's dance party is torn. Paige very much wants to go to the party but she cannot go without a dress.

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.desc: In Rainbow Village, people are busy preparing for a dance marathon, a competition in which all of the villagers participate. Ling Ling is very sad that Ellie decided not to participate. Ellie is not a confident dancer so she doesn't want to participate. // Rainbow Ruby's friends tell her that they are now friends with Felicia. They were playing hide and seek but Felicia is such a good hider that she's refused to come out even though she's won the game.

programme.title: RiffTrax: Trucker's Woman
programme.desc: If the old dusty carousel of audio cassettes at a truck stop could be distilled into a movie, this would be that movie. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from MST3K.

programme.title: RiffTrax: Killers From Space
programme.desc: When an atomic bomb test triggers the arrival of invaders from another planet, some hack director combined the dumbest plots of a dozen b-movies into a single film! This feature contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary from RiffTrax.

programme.title: RiffTrax Live: Amityville - The Evil Escapes
programme.desc: There's still evil up there at the old Amityville house. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin and Bill from MST3K.

programme.title: RiffTrax: Terror at Tenkiller
programme.desc: Follow-up to the rarely seen, totally imaginary films Ennui at Eightkiller and Nausea at Ninekiller, Terror at Tenkiller really brings the goods! And by “the goods” we mostly mean there’s a character named Tor in it.

programme.title: RiffTrax: Star Games
programme.desc: Star Games! If you've ever asked what it would be like if Greydon Clark, the infamous director of Final Justice and Angels' Revenge, tried his hand at a science fiction movie.

programme.title: RiffTrax Shorts: Six Murderous Beliefs
programme.desc: These beliefs are bad, and not just “the Tim Burton Planet of the Apes is the best version” bad. They're seriously bad. This short is a parody and contains a comedic commentary by RiffTrax.

programme.title: RiffTrax: Bounty Tracker
programme.desc: Lorenzo Lamas is a Bounty Tracker in the movie Bounty Tracker. This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by Mike, Kevin, and Bill from RiffTrax (formerly of MST3K).

programme.title: RiffTrax Presents: Fear
programme.desc: Medical student Larry has lost his scholarship! Or has he? This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by Mary Jo and Bridget from RiffTrax.

programme.title: RiffTrax Short: Overcoming Fear
programme.desc: Fear: Most of us rejected it in the mid-90s by wearing trendy t-shirts emblazoned with slogans such as "Second Place is the First Loser."

programme.title: Rifftrax Shorts: What Are Letters For? And What Makes Things Float?
programme.desc: Here are two classic RiffTrax shorts, What Makes Things Float & What Are Letters For. RiffTrax Mike, Kevin, and Bill provide a comedic commentary on this parody of the original movie.

programme.title: RiffTrax: Maniac

programme.title: uvres de Haydn, Mozart et Saint-Saëns
Hans van Manen – Moving to Music
Roberto Giordano joue Brahms et Beethoven
Ana María Paño-Osorio & Philharmonie de Paris
programme.sub-title: Sinfonía por el Perú from Philharmonie de Paris
programme.desc: Superstar tenor Juan Diego Flórez brings to life the most iconic roles of the bel canto repertoire, joined by the vibrant young musicians of Sinfonía por el Perú, led by the celebrated conductor Ana María Patiño-Osorio! Embark on a lyrical adventure with them, from the powerful drama of Bellini's I Capuleti e I Montecchi and the majestic Jerusalem by Verdi, to the boisterous and spirited cancan of Offenbach's operetta Orpheus in the Underworld. Sinfonía por el Perú is a nonprofit organization founded by Juan Diego Flórez, with a mission to inspire social change through collective music education. Since its inception in 2011, over six thousand young Peruvians have embraced the opportunity to play an instrument or sing in a choir. Students from the program have graced the world's most prestigious stages, from Salzburg to Gstaad, including the Lucerne Festival, and they accompany Juan Diego Flórez for this concert.

programme.title: Ballet of the Mariinsky Theatre
programme.desc: 'La Bayadère' is a three-act ballet by the French choreographer Marius Petipa. Set in 19th-century India, 'La Bayadère' tells the sad love story of the noble warrior Solor and his Nikia, a temple dancer or 'bayadère', who is poisoned by her rival, Gamzatti. The ballet features one of the most celebrated scenes of classical ballet, namely 'The Kingdom of the Shades'. In this iconic scene, Solor dreams, under the influence of opium, of reuniting with his beloved Nikia. This production of the ballet features the revised choreography by Vladimir Ponomarev and Vakhtang Chabukiani (1941), and includes dances by Konstantin Sergeyev and Nikolai Zubkovsky. The ballet's music, composed by Ludwig Minkus, is performed by the Mariinsky Orchestra under the direction of Boris Gruzin. Among the performers are Viktoria Tereshkina, Anastasia Matvienko, Vladimir Shklyarov, and Vladimir Ponomarev. This performance was recorded at the Mariinsky Theatre in St. Petersburg, Russia, in July 2014.

programme.title: Maya Oganyan, Eduard Topchjan & Armenian Philharmonic Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor, Op. 37. Russian-born pianist Maya Oganyan (*2005) makes her solo debut with the orchestra. Beethoven composed this concerto in 1800 and played the piano part himself at the piece's premiere in 1803. Like two of his other major works –Symphony No. 5 and Piano Sonata No. 8 ‘Pathétique' – this piano concerto is written in the key of C minor, which contributes to the work's stormy character. As an encore, Oganyan performs Der Bote (‘The Messenger') by Ukrainian composer Valentin Silvestrov. This performance was recorded at the Aram Khachaturian Concert Hall in Yerevan, Armenia, in 2021.

programme.title: Jos van Immerseel, Anima Eterna Brugge, Claron McFadden & Bart Van Caenegem
programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge in a concert program dedicated to American composer George Gershwin. The program opens with Gershwin's symphonic suite Catfish Row (arr. Steven D. Bowen) which is based upon music from his famous opera Porgy and Bess (1935). This is followed by the well-known tone poem An American in Paris (1928). After, soprano Claron McFadden joins the orchestra, presenting a selection of Gershwin's classic jazz songs, including ‘The man I love' (1924-27), ‘I got rhythm' (1930), and ‘By Strauss' (1936). She also performs ‘My man's gone now' and ‘Summertime' from Porgy and Bess. The concert ends with Gershwin's celebrated Rhapsody in Blue, with Bart Van Caenegem as featured pianist. This performance was recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on March 3, 2017.

programme.title: Non élucidé
programme.desc: Paquita Parra a été retrouvée morte, carbonisée, à l'intérieur de sa voiture, à Puymoyen, dans la banlieue d'Angoulême, le 4 décembre 1998. programme.title: Non élucidé

La victime a été battue à mort. Qui Magalie a-t-elle croisé ce jour-là ? Quel mobile peut expliquer ce crime ?

programme.title: Non élucidé

programme.title: Non élucidé

Il est retrouvé noyé le 24 décembre. Une information est ouverte pour homicide volontaire, mais le crime n'a jamais été élucidé.

programme.title: Non élucidé

programme.desc: Une jeune femme tente de découvrir l'identité de l'auteur d'une carte de voeux reçue à l'adolescence et retrouvée par hasard dans la maison familiale.

programme.title: A Cape Cod Christmas
programme.desc: Une auteure de livres pour enfants, qui souhaite vendre la maison familiale, retrouve son amour de jeunesse, qui va l'aider à conserver ce lieu qu'elle aime tant.

programme.title: Le calendrier secret de Noël
programme.desc: Katie, romancière quelque peu désabusée, se rend dans la pittoresque petite ville d'Evergreen pour les vacances et se laisse gagner par la féerie de Noël.

programme.title: Les petits miracles de Noël
programme.desc: Pour aider une amie qui prépare son mariage, une femme propose son aide afin de soulager cette dernière, ignorant qu'elle va mettre son propre couple en péril.

programme.title: Petits plats en équilibre
programme.desc: Chaque jour, Laurent Mariotte propose des recettes simples et savoureuses pour profiter des ingrédients de saison, en donnant la part belle aux produits locaux.

programme.title: Mentalist
programme.desc: Le FBI ne dispose que de deux jours pour établir l'innocence d'un prisonnier condamné à mort. La sentence doit en effet être exécutée 48 heures plus tard.

programme.title: Mentalist
programme.desc: Après le meurtre d'une prostituée, une piste sérieuse conduit les enquêteurs à un chalet, fréquenté par un célèbre joueur de golf : un suspect potentiel.

programme.title: Mentalist
programme.desc: C'est par hasard que Jane met au jour un réseau organisé de traite d'êtres humains. Lisbon réfléchit à la proposition de Pike de le rejoindre à Washington.

programme.title: Mentalist
programme.desc: Jane pourrait bien être poursuivi par la justice pour le meurtre de John le Rouge. Cho et Abbott poursuivent leur enquête sur le trafic d'êtres humains.

programme.title: Mentalist
programme.desc: Pendant que le FBI enquête sur des prélèvements d'organes illégaux, Patrick Jane et Teresa Lisbon cherchent activement de jeunes filles kidnappées.

programme.title: Petits plats en équilibre

programme.title: Quotidien, deuxième partie
programme.desc: Yann Barthès et son équipe vous proposent un rendez-vous incontournable mêlant information, culture, sport et humour. Cette émission dynamique offre un panorama complet de l'actualité, abordant des sujets variés avec un ton à la fois sérieux et léger. Un moment de divertissement intelligent pour rester informé tout en se détendant.

programme.title: 90' Enquêtes
programme.desc: Valenciennes et Denain mobilisent près de 700 policiers. Pendant plus de deux mois, une équipe a suivi le travail quotidien de deux unités emblématiques : Police-secours et la Brigade Anti-Criminalité. Les policiers gèrent des refus d'obtempérer, des conflits de voisinage, mais aussi des tensions conjugales.

programme.title: 90' Enquêtes
programme.desc: Chaque jour, les 500 policiers de Roubaix gèrent toutes sortes de conflits : bagarres, rixes entre voisins, cambriolages ou encore courses-poursuites. Ancienne capitale de l'industrie textile, cette ville du Nord fait partie des vingt agglomérations françaises les plus touchées par la délinquance.

programme.desc: Mengisahkan dua insan yang terikat oleh cinta dari kehidupan lampau. Walaupun dilahirkan semula dalam kehidupan masa kini, tanpa ingatan silam, mereka membangkitkan perasaan yang sukar dijelaskan. Cinta yang kembali berputik diuji oleh takdir dan rahsia masa lalu. Lakonan : Tack Parunyu Rojanawuttitum, Film Thanapat Kawala, Pechaya Wattanamontri, Sinjai Plengpanich dan ramai lagi.

programme.title: Mithra
programme.desc: Sumalatha dan keluarganya bertungkus-lumus mencari jalan penyelesaian untuk mendapatkan duit sebanyak lima juta ringgit. Sumalatha terpaksa meredah pelbagai cabaran untuk mendapatkan jumlah duit tersebut. Isteri dan adik ipar Jayakumar berjaya melarikan diri daripada cengkaman samseng. programme.title: Khabar Dari Casablanca
programme.desc: Kisah kehidupan sepasang suami isteri romantis yang bekerja di luar negara. Akibat satu insiden, suaminya hilang dan tidak dapat dikesan dan ramai percaya bahawa dia telah meninggal dunia. Isterinya tidak dapat menerima berita tersebut sebaliknya yakin yang suaminya masih hidup. Dia terus menghantar emel kepada suaminya sehingga dituduh tidak siuman dan dimasukkan ke hospital sakit jiwa.

Ketegangan memuncak apabila tugas Maria membawanya kepada penjenayah yang mempunyai kaitan dengan Mariana, sekali gus menguji keutuhan ikatan persaudaraan mereka dalam mengharungi dugaan besar

Na tropach historii
programme.desc: Cykl przybliżający historię województwa świętokrzyskiego. Opisując zrywy narodowe, klęski, wielkie i małe zwycięstwa, najnowsze odkrycia archeologiczne i geologiczne. Podążamy śladami, które pozostawiła historia.

programme.title: Komisarz Alex
programme.desc: Snajper strzela do ludzi na bazarze. Ginie mężczyzna badający aferę finansową. Odsunięta od śledztwa Monika prowadzi własne dochodzenie, które łączy się z jej przeszłością.

programme.title: Ranczo
programme.desc: Kontynuacja popularnego serialu komediowego o tematyce obyczajowej. Serial opowiada o perypetiach młodej Amerykanki, która na skutek splotu różnych okoliczności życiowych osiedla się w małej, podlaskiej wsi Wilkowyje.

programme.title: Polacy światu
programme.desc: Aleksander Brückner wybitny slawista, badacz języka i kultury polskiej urodził się 29 stycznia 1856 roku w Tarnopolu. Kształcił się w Lipsku, Berlinie i Wiedniu. W wieku 25 lat rozpoczął współpracę z katedrą języków i literatur słowiańskich.

programme.title: Pan Mama
programme.desc: Patrycja odkrywa, że jej postać w serialu zostanie uśmiercona, a Zuza organizuje internetową kampanię ratunkową. Sylwester unika rozmowy z Mają o stracie mamy, ale w końcu musi się z tym zmierzyć. Patrycja dostaje rolę życia. Czy wyprowadzi się i zniknie z rodziny Dzików?

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia
programme.desc: Kiedy Adam ponownie powraca do domu Pyrków pod wpływem środków odurzających i pozbawia domowników zapasów na śniadanie, Joanna z trudem panuje nad wzburzeniem. Lokator nie traci jednak rezonu i wkrótce prosi Huberta o kolejną pożyczkę.

programme.title: Stulecie Winnych
programme.desc: Jasiek jest przetrzymywany w areszcie. Władek i Kazia są bezsilni. Wiedzą, że Łucja widziała całe zdarzenie, ale milczy. Proszą o pomoc Bronię. Babka Winna żąda, by dziewczyna powiedziała policji prawdę. Posuwa się do groźby.

programme.title: Ojciec Mateusz
programme.desc: W klasie Zosi Nocul jest nowa uczennica Julka, dziewczynki zaprzyjaźniają się. Rodzina Julki przeprowadziła się do Sandomierza, chroni ich policja. Ojciec jest świadkiem koronnym w procesie mafii. W szkole trwają poszukiwania Zosi i Julki.

programme.title: Profesor Michałowski. Droga do Faras
programme.desc: Historia najwybitniejszego polskiego archeologa, prof. Kazimierza Michałowskiego i jego największego odkrycia w Faras. Bez jego determinacji i pasji nie byłoby polskiej archeologii z jej międzynarodowymi sukcesami i pozycją, jaką ma dziś.

programme.title: Pan Mama
programme.desc: Bruno udaje przed dziewczyną, że jest piłkarzem, chociaż nie potrafi grać. Za to Zuza staje się cleanfluencerką, która nie potrafi sprzątać, a Maja wspomina przygody z mamą, w które nikt nie chce jej uwierzyć.

programme.title: Tylko jeden skecz
programme.desc: Pogram montażowy, w którym prezentujemy znane i lubiane skecze. W programie "Czeska piosenka" w wykonaniu Kabaretu Ani Mru Mru.

programme.title: Wojenne dziewczyny
programme.desc: Major Powała przesłuchuje Kamila Brodzkiego. Nie wierzy, że porucznik cierpi na całkowitą amnezję. Do pokoju wchodzi niespodziewanie Irka, podbiega do Kamila, lecz on jej nie poznaje. Irka ma żal do brata, że ukrywał przed nią prawdę.

programme.title: Dom
programme.desc: W kamienicy na Złotej pojawia się pierwszy telewizor. Szczęśliwymi posiadaczami są Wrotkowie. Andrzej i Wiktor chcą postawić na cmentarzu w Sierpuchowie pomnik upamiętniający walkę i śmierć ich przyjaciół z AK.

programme.title: Polscy szpiedzy
programme.desc: Gościem programu jest były oficer wywiadu wojskowego Maciej Moryc. W rozmowie opowiada o swojej służbie podczas misji w Afganistanie, specyfice pracy wywiadowczej w strefie działań wojennych oraz wyzwaniach, z jakimi mierzyli się polscy oficerowie. Jak zdobywa się informacje w kraju ogarniętym konfliktem i jak wygląda praca wywiadu na współczesnym polu walki?

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia
programme.desc: Kiedy Adam ponownie powraca do domu Pyrków pod wpływem środków odurzających i pozbawia domowników zapasów na śniadanie, Joanna z trudem panuje nad wzburzeniem. Lokator nie traci jednak rezonu i wkrótce prosi Huberta o kolejną pożyczkę.

programme.title: Przyrodnik na tropie
programme.desc: Dawno temu wierzono, że dąb był pierwszym drzewem na świecie. Wierzono, że tylko błyskawica z nieba była w stanie go pokonać. Był drzewem świętym, królewskim.

programme.title: Okrasa łamie przepisy
programme.desc: W tym odcinku Karol Okrasa w miejscowości Nowe Radzikowo w pobliżu Czerwińska nad Wisłą spotyka się z paniami z Koła Gospodyń Wiejskich, które odtwarzają dawne przepisy. Jedną z takich ciekawych potraw są placki z buraka cukrowego.

programme.title: Polacy na ratunek Żydom
programme.desc: W tym odcinku Irena Karczewska z domu Weisberg opowiada historię swojej rodziny, jej losów w trakcie wojny i osób, które pomogły jej w tym trudnym czasie.

programme.title: Stulecie Winnych
programme.desc: Jasiek jest przetrzymywany w areszcie. Władek i Kazia są bezsilni. Wiedzą, że Łucja widziała całe zdarzenie, ale milczy. Proszą o pomoc Bronię. Babka Winna żąda, by dziewczyna powiedziała policji prawdę. Posuwa się do groźby.

programme.title: Stawka większa niż życie
programme.desc: Do Berlina wyrusza łączniczka podziemnej organizacji z bardzo ważnymi informacjami. Ma je przekazać agentce - szwedzkiej aktorce Christin Kield. W rzeczywistości Christin jest agentką podwójną.

programme.title: Vito odkrywa Polskę
programme.desc: Tym razem Vito odwiedził pradawną krainę, czyli Jurę Krakowsko - Częstochowską. Wspinał się na wapienne skały w Rzędkowicach, odwiedził swojego rodaka w pizzerii i dowiedział się, czemu budowano zamki obronne na słynnym szlaku Orlich Gniazd.

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia
programme.desc: Celina kontynuuje działania w sprawie Justina, co spotyka się z wyraźnym niezadowoleniem ze strony Łukasza. Ostatecznie Brońska przekazuje zgromadzone dowody komisarzowi Majakowi, zwracając się do funkcjonariusza z prośbą o interwencję.

programme.title: Dziewczyna ze zdjęcia
programme.desc: W 2022 r. IPN z okazji 8 marca upublicznił kilka zdjęć archiwalnych przedstawiających Polki. Wśród nich uwagę przykuwała fotografia młodej dziewczyny w mundurze wojskowymi i furażerce. To jedno z 40 milionów zdjęć znajdujących się w IPN.

programme.title: Niezwykłe miejsca
programme.desc: Reportaże o charakterze edukacyjnym prezentujące niezwykłe miejsca w Polsce. Miejsca znane i mniej znane, często zapomniane. Prowadzący przenoszą widza do minionych epok, uwzględniając dokonania współczesnych konserwatorów, historyków.

programme.title: Cisza nad rozlewiskiem
programme.desc: Nad rozlewiskiem ogólny smutek, trwają przygotowania do pogrzebu Kaśki. Małgosia jest załamana, a do tego musi zająć się wszystkimi pod nieobecność Basi. Rysio załamany po nieudanych urodzinach postanawia razem z Bronią uciec z domu.

programme.title: Cisza nad rozlewiskiem
programme.desc: Po śmierci Kasi Basia postanawia znowu opuścić rozlewisko. Wyjeżdża do Indii, by odnaleźć duchowy spokój. Krzysztof zdecydował - nie wyjedzie do Szczytna. Postanawia związać życie z Marysią i coraz lepiej czuje się w roli przyszłego ojca.

programme.title: Rozmowy (nie)wygodne
programme.desc: Inspirujące rozmowy Mariusza Szczygła z wybitnymi osobowościami świata kultury i sztuki. Prowokujące pytania, wymagające nieszablonowych odpowiedzi i odkrywania swojej osobowości. Wywiady odbywać się będą we "Wrzenie Świata" - miejscu spotkań bohemy intelektualnej Warszawy. Gość: Joanna Kurowska, aktorka.

programme.title: Wielki test
programme.desc: Czy wiemy, jak bardzo nasze życie zależy od przyrody i jej różnorodności? Bioróżnorodność to nie tylko bogactwo gatunków roślin i zwierząt, ale także nasze zdrowie, żywność, czyste powietrze i bezpieczeństwo przyszłych pokoleń. W Wielkim Teście o Bioróżnorodności sprawdzimy, ile wiemy o świecie natury i jak możemy go chronić. Bo troska o przyrodę to tak naprawdę troska o nas samych.

Jones finds himself drawn to Dorothy, despite her unattainable status. Soon a rivalry between his unsavory crew and the prim and proper pilgrims emerges.

programme.desc: In London, orphan Geoff Bramer (Freddie Bartholomew) helps thieves Doris (Gale Sondergaard) and Jim (George Zucco) with a racket stealing from jewelry stores. Once apprehended, Geoff is sent to a mariner's academy run by kindly headmaster Capt. Briggs (Charles Coburn) that houses orphaned boys. Geoff resists the school's discipline and runs away, but school leader Terry O'Mulvaney (Mickey Rooney) brings him back, then refuses to tell on him -- prompting Geoff to reconsider his attitude.

programme.title: Sweethearts
programme.desc: Happily married New York City stage actors Ernest Lane (Nelson Eddy) and Gwen Marlowe (Jeanette MacDonald) are stars of a successful Broadway production. However, when the couple is wooed by Hollywood, the team behind the play, including theater producer Felix Lehman (Frank Morgan), launches a scheme to prevent their move to the West Coast. While the deception works, it also causes the charming pair to split. Can Ernest and Gwen see through the lies and rekindle their love?

programme.title: A Christmas Carol
programme.desc: Crotchety miser Ebenezer Scrooge (Reginald Owen) hates Christmas and mistreats his long-suffering employee, devoted family man Bob Cratchit (Gene Lockhart). But a visit from the ghost of his former business partner Jacob Marley (Leo G. Carroll) and three Christmas spirits (Lionel Braham, Ann Rutherford, D'Arcy Corrigan) might convince him to change his ways and become more kindhearted. This adaptation of the Charles Dickens classic became a holiday staple for decades.

programme.title: Goodbye, Mr. Chips
programme.desc: Young schoolteacher Charles Edward Chipping (Robert Donat) imposes strict discipline on his young charges at a Victorian-era English public school, becoming a fearsome presence on the campus grounds. But the love of spirited young suffragette Katherine Ellis (Greer Garson) brings the Latin instructor out of his shell and makes him a beloved campus institution into the 20th century and through the shattering violence of World War I. The film is based on the best-selling novel by James Hilton.

programme.title: Andy Hardy Gets Spring Fever
programme.desc: In the small town of Carvel, Judge James Hardy (Lewis Stone) learns from a chemist and promoter that a plot of land always considered worthless is actually rich in bauxite, a mineral used to make aluminum. After verifying the claim, the judge urges his friends and neighbors to invest in the land with him. Meanwhile, the judge's teenage son, Andy (Mickey Rooney), falls for a new teacher after getting dumped by his girlfriend. Both the judge and Andy learn that things aren't what they seem.

programme.title: A Yank at Eton
programme.desc: Dismayed when his mother marries Englishman Roger Carlton (Ian Hunter), teenager Tim Dennis (Mickey Rooney) chafes at leaving America and his college football dreams to move to England. His mother convinces Tim to try Eton College for six months, but once there he clashes with the traditions of the conservative students -- who are led by Roger's son, school head boy Peter (Freddie Bartholomew). When Tim's girlfriend shows an interest in Peter, Tim's response nearly causes disaster.

programme.title: National Velvet
programme.desc: When Velvet Brown (Elizabeth Taylor), an equine-loving 12-year-old living in rural Sussex, becomes the owner of a rambunctious horse, she decides to train it for England's Grand National race. Aided by former jockey Mi Taylor (Mickey Rooney) and encouraged by her family, the determined Velvet gets her steed, affectionately called "The Pie," ready for the big day. However, a last-minute problem arises with the jockey and an unexpected rider must step in as a replacement.

programme.title: Fortunes of Captain Blood

After Riconete finally catches Blood's crew on an island, Blood must go incognito to rescue his men, all with the help of Riconete's niece Isabelita (Patricia Medina).

programme.title: Brigadoon
programme.desc: Tommy Albright (Gene Kelly) and Jeff Douglas (Van Johnson), two American pals on a Scottish hunting trip, get lost in the woods and come upon the magical village of Brigadoon. Rising out of the Scottish mist only once every 100 years, and only for one day, Brigadoon is an enchanted place where life is simpler and easier, untouched by the worries of the modern world. When Tommy falls for beautiful villager Fiona Campbell (Cyd Charisse), he must decide whether to stay or to return to his life.

programme.title: Annie Get Your Gun

While Annie and Frank are performing as part of the famous traveling show headlined by the legendary Buffalo Bill (Louis Calhern), the two compete and flirt, with plenty of ups and downs along the way.

Puis Nicolas Hulot est parti à la rencontre des requins et des sardines, avant de prendre le pouls de la migration des zèbres. Il a achevé son périple à Cape Town, territoire du grand requin blanc.

Дълбините на Австралия S1 E1 Изследвайте бреговете на Северната територия и водите на Големия бариерен риф, където биоложката Лизи Дейли проучва защо толкова много странни и смъртоносни същества живеят в този отдалечен район.

Гладиатори S1 E2 Австралия е земя, отделена от другите от времето на динозаврите; изолирана в продължение на милиони години, еволюцията е превърнала нейните животни в най-впечатляващите гладиатори на планетата.

programme.desc: Lester兼具民俗音樂及紋身創作的多重身份。他曾任獨立樂隊「觸執毛」的吉他手，並在設計領域追求美學。多年來，他在藝術界的努力使他成為專業創作者，並深受素食和修佛理念的啟發，使創作更具意義。近年，他專注於民俗音樂的研究，透過樂器及表演形式深化自我成長，並以此組建樂隊「I is one」，曾在Clockenflap表演，結合修行與哲理元素。此外，他創立了素食餐廳「余地」，寓意生活中的選擇，倡導以簡單方式將素食與生活結合，Lester相信，藝術的價值在於實踐，而非高深的理論，展現了他對藝術和生活的熱誠。

"The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. programme.desc: People who grew up in the Chicago area in the 1960s and '70s are likely familiar with the characters of Bozo the Clown, Garfield Goose and Ray Rayner, who were staples on their respective children's programs on WGN during that period. This annual holiday special provides a look back at the shows that featured the popular characters -- various incarnations of "Bozo's Circus," "Garfield Goose and Friends" and "Ray Rayner and His Friends." Also included are three animated shorts that have aired on WGN for many years -- "Hardrock, Coco and Joe: The Three Little Dwarfs," "Suzy Snowflake" and the 1954 version of "Frosty the Snowman." WGN's Dean Richards hosts.

programme.title: 貨櫃大戰第2季:9
programme.desc: 該系列發生在商業航運港口，以一群來自不同背景的專家為中心，他們花費數万美元爭奪來自世界各地的高價航運集裝箱的內容。 由於只有幾分鐘的時間來評估集裝箱並決定是否出價，隨著他們大獲全勝或空手回家，壓力會越來越大。

programme.title: 貨櫃大戰第2季:10
programme.desc: 該系列發生在商業航運港口，以一群來自不同背景的專家為中心，他們花費數万美元爭奪來自世界各地的高價航運集裝箱的內容。 由於只有幾分鐘的時間來評估集裝箱並決定是否出價，隨著他們大獲全勝或空手回家，壓力會越來越大。

programme.title: 心計第6季:17
programme.desc: 西蒙·貝克（Simon Baker）飾演派屈克·簡（Patrick Jane），一名受僱於加州調查局（California Bureau of Investigation，CBI）之獨立顧問。他利用出色的觀察技巧（如讀心術），成功偵破多宗大案。他過去經常使用所謂的心靈感應，曾假裝擁有通靈能力的靈媒而成名。派屈克·簡在一電視節目透露使用心靈感應協助警方調查連環殺手「紅約翰」（Red John），他的妻女因而被其殺害。在自責之下，他放棄作為騙人的靈媒，成為警方顧問。

programme.title: 卡那洛效應第4季:16
programme.desc: 麥可卡那洛是一個職業魔術師，卻是個愛開玩笑的人，他在一些很平常的場合裡，對一些猜想不到的人表演難解的魔術，全都被隱藏式攝影機拍下。

programme.title: 生活冷知識第3季:3
programme.desc: 歡迎來到由 Kevin Pereira 和 Brooke Van Poppelen 主持的每週節目，該節目以喜劇形式講述了永無止境的日常生活小貼士。 從學習如何用鞋子打開一瓶酒，到找出衛生紙捲的多種用途，永遠不乏有待發現的訣竅。 觀眾請注意：你們的生活將永遠不一樣。

programme.title: 好友互整第6季:13
programme.desc: 節目的四位主角是從小一起長大的死黨，他們的任務是輪番被整，他們從小就愛拿最令人難堪、不舒服的挑戰來嗆對方。

programme.title: 馬克羅伯的復仇製造所第1季:1
programme.desc: 這個全新系列堪稱宅宅的逆襲，前NASA工程師和現任蘋果工程師，在網路上的亮片惡作劇影片有5200萬觀看次數，證明書呆子也能闖出一片天。加入馬克羅伯的專家團隊，懲罰那些沒有道德的人。設置陷阱、放誘餌，然後等待壞人上鉤。

programme.title: 馬克羅伯的復仇製造所第1季:2
programme.desc: 這個全新系列堪稱宅宅的逆襲，前NASA工程師和現任蘋果工程師，在網路上的亮片惡作劇影片有5200萬觀看次數，證明書呆子也能闖出一片天。加入馬克羅伯的專家團隊，懲罰那些沒有道德的人。設置陷阱、放誘餌，然後等待壞人上鉤。

programme.title: 宅男行不行第8季:5
programme.desc: 在上一季的結尾，萊納德和佩妮宣佈訂婚，他們和謝爾頓商量讓他搬出公寓，女友艾米建議謝爾頓與她同居，這把謝爾頓嚇壞了。與此同時，他們最愛的漫畫店慘遭火災。謝爾頓一時間難以接受生活中的種種變故，負氣出走。一個多月過去了，謝爾頓會在這場跨越美國大陸的旅程中遭遇什麼？在新的一季中，其他幾位主角的生活也有新變化。佩妮放棄了演藝事業，正式踏入了藥品推銷之路，她與伯納黛特將會成為同事。霍華德最煩惱的事是，自己的媽媽和漫畫店老闆斯圖爾特住在一起。單身漢拉傑什何時才能找到女朋友？

programme.title: 六人行第7季:8
programme.desc: 菲比（莉莎·庫卓 Lisa Kudrow 飾）和瑞秋（詹妮弗·安妮斯頓 Jennifer Aniston 飾）的公寓已經修復完畢，菲比搬回了公寓，瑞秋繼續和喬伊（馬特·理勃蘭 Matt LeBlanc 飾）住在一起。喬伊在《Days of Our Lives》劇組裡得到了一個角色。就在錢德勒（馬修·派瑞 Matthew Perry 飾）和摩妮卡（柯特妮·考克斯 Courteney Cox 飾）的婚禮前一夜，錢德勒突然臨陣畏縮，逃走躲了起來。他走了之後，菲比在衛生間找了一支顯示有孕的驗孕棒，從而斷定摩妮卡有了身孕。菲比和羅斯（大衛·史威默 David Schwimmer 飾）在辦公室找到了躲藏錢德勒並說服他回來，回來後他聽到了菲比與瑞秋的竊竊私語——摩妮卡懷孕了！最後錢德勒和摩妮卡順利完婚，但摩妮卡卻說自己並沒有懷孕時。那麼，懷孕的人難道是瑞秋嗎？

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor head to the iconic Seven Mile Bridge targeting big jack crevasses and permit.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor head offshore to the Marathon Hump, taking advantage of the 26-feet hybrid boat's versatility to find some exciting Blackfin and Skipjack Tuna fishing.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor are joined by scientist Nick Haddad, who educates our hosts and the fishing world on the various descending devices used to preserve stressed catch from deeper waters as the three of them get into some fun Red Snapper fishing off the coast of Marathon, Florida in the Keys.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.sub-title: Saltwater Experience - "Baby Tarpon With Captain Reed
programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor are joined by Rich's son Reed, who takes the wheel and directs the team into some amazing early morning baby tarpon fishing in the Everglades.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.sub-title: Saltwater Experience - "Combat Fishing With Hunter Smallback
programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor take Hunter Smallback into the Everglades for some snook fishing, and the action really heats up when some hungry Lemon sharks crash the party.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.sub-title: Saltwater Experience - "Two Out Of Three Ain't Bad
programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor catch two thirds of a slam when they bring Tom's new Yellowfin 24' Bay up to Key Largo for some exciting flats fishing.

programme.title: Captain's Log
programme.desc: Capt. Jonathan Moss is in Florida's Big Bend, inshore fishing the Negative Low Tide on an Airboat!

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: The next stop on our Florida Keys adventure brings Rush Maltz to the legendary waters of Islamorada — a destination known for its laid-back island vibe, world-class fishing, fine dining, and easy access to the reef. Joining locals Jimmy Hendrix and Jordi Hortensi, the game plan is simple: check in by boat, chase fish, eat well, and go dive. From kite fishing the reef to fresh seafood and great company, this episode is all about experiencing the true rhythm of a Florida Keys vacation.

programme.title: Road Trip Angler
programme.sub-title: Road Trip Angler - "Fishing Florida's Forgotten Coast
programme.desc: In this episode of Road Trip Angler, host Jameson Redding takes guests Jesse Laspeyre and Brooks Beatty on a multi-day adventure exploring the Forgotten Coast along the Florida Adventure Trail, chasing fish and adventure at every turn.

programme.title: Destination Dive
programme.sub-title: Destination Dive - "Lower Key - Big Pine Key
programme.desc: Experience the magic of shore diving from one of the Keys' most scenic beaches. The episode also follows military veterans discovering healing and renewed purpose through diving.

programme.title: Dirt
programme.sub-title: DIRT - "Exploring New York City's Hidden Culinary Gems: Cooking Goat Brains, Lobster & MORE
programme.desc: New. York. City. That's where our host Josh Rosen kicks off his journey in Episode 4—and where he lived for 16 years and started up the surf-centric apparel brand, Saturdays NYC. Back in his old stomping grounds, Josh first meets up with the award-winning chef and Mumbai native, Chintan Pandya, currently blowing up the New York food scene with his unapologetic and authentic Indian cuisine (pro tip: try the goat brains). Next, Josh travels through the boroughs, heads upstate, and along the coast to source local ingredients—from sake brewers and pig farmers to catching fresh lobster just 100 miles from Wall Street. As always the adventure will end with a feast, right back in Chintan's kitchen.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: In the heart of the Zambezi Delta, a team of conservationists have overseen one of the largest range expansions of African lions in modern times. From a reintroduction of 24 lions in 2018, today the population is more than a hundred.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.sub-title: The Green Way Outdoors - "The Coca-Cola Woods
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff wade into the flooded timber of the legendary Coca-Cola Woods, where mallards drop through the treetops in waves. Amidst echoes of calling and wingbeats, they experience one of America's most iconic duck hunts.

programme.title: Mëkate dhe trëndafila
programme.desc: Një sekret i fshehur për vite me radhë. Një familje në prag të shkatërrimit. Dhe një dashuri që lind mes dhimbjes dhe së vërtetës. Çdo trëndafil fsheh një sekret dhe çdo mëkat ka një çmim. Ai besonte te familja. Ajo besonte te e vërteta. Por kur sekretet dalin në dritë, asgjë nuk mbetet si më parë. Dashuri, tradhti dhe emocione që sfidojnë fatin. Me aktoret e famshem: Cemre Baysel dhe Murat Yildirim.

programme.title: Rudina
programme.desc: Një show argëtues dhe informativ nga Rudina Magjistari, që e shoqeron çdo pasdite familjet shqiptare me të ftuar të shumtë e VIP, por dhe njerez të e thjeshte me historitë e tyre personale.

programme.title: Mashtruesit
programme.desc: Një dramë e mbushur me intriga, sekrete, dhe lojëra të rrezikshme, ku e vërteta dhe gënjeshtra ndërthuren në çdo hap. Ertan, një avokat i talentuar i cili së bashku me të atin, nuk heziton të përdorë metoda të pazakonta për të fituar çështjet e tyre dhe Asja, një grua që përballet me vështirësi të mëdha dhe detyrohet të përdorë zgjuarsinë dhe mashtrimin për të mbajtur familjen e saj. Sa më shumë zbulohen sekretet, aq më shumë bëhet e vështirë të dallosh se kush është viktimë, kush është mashtrue.

programme.title: Lajme
programme.desc: Lajme nga vendi dhe bota.

programme.title: STOP
programme.desc: Aktualiteti shqiptar ”alla Stop”, problematika e njerëzve të thjeshtë, që pasi kanë trokitur në të gjitha dyert, gjejnë zgjidhje vetëm në ”Stop” , video-kamera të fshehta, që denoncojnë e demaskojnë korrupsionin, dhunën apo abuzimin seksual. Akte humanizmi për më të pamundurit e fatkeqët, të cilëve u ndryshon jeta. Nje emision i gjithi vetëm për njerëzit e zakonshëm dhe me njerëzit në qendër.

programme.title: Gjeniu
programme.desc: Një gjeni i tradhëtuar nga njeriu që duhej ta mbronte. Mes sekreteve, pushtetit dhe lojërave të mendjes, fillon një betejë ku fiton vetëm më i zgjuari. Devran është një djalë me inteligjencë të jashtëzakonshme, jeta e të cilit ndryshon për shkak të tradhtisë së babait të tij. Një lojë të rrezikshme mendjesh, ku çdo lëvizje është e llogaritur dhe çdo aleancë mund të fshehë një tradhti. Ndërsa sekretet e së kaluarës dalin në dritë, Devrani duhet të zgjedhë mes hakmarrjes dhe njerëzve që do. Fitues.

programme.title: Opinion
programme.desc: Emisioni politik më i ndjekur dhe më i preferuar në ekranet shqiptare nga Blendi Fevziu. Arena e politikës shqiptare që prej 31 gushtit 1997. Komente, analiza, debate, personazhe, dëshmi dhe fakte konkrete. Ngjarjet më të fundit dhe më të rëndësishme.

programme.title: Aldo Morning Show
programme.desc: Dielli lind ndryshe në TVKLAN, në 7 pa 1 minutë! Të lodhur apo të palodhur nga gjumi i natës, nga e djeshmja me halle e strese, Aldo ju fton të zgjohemi me buzeqeshje, me qeshje, me nënqeshje, dhe më kryesorja. me një adrenaline të paparë për ta nisu.

programme.title: Shije Shtepie
programme.desc: Emision edukues - informues - argëtues me zn.Tefta e Katerina Trungu. Çdo ditë me recetat e thjeshta dhe mbi të gjitha ekonomike të Zj.Vjollca duke edukuar amvisat si të ushqehemi shëndetshëm. Rubrika te ndryshme me te ftuar speciale me këshilla te thjeshta praktike, të kuptueshme nga te gjithë, për cdo aspekt të të përditshmes.

programme.title: Shtëpiake të dëshpëruara
programme.desc: Komedia me skenarin me te mire te pershtatur nga versioni amerikan. Jeta dhe dashurite e pese heroinave te serialit qe jetojne ne rrugicen ”Trendafil”: Jasemin, Nermin, Zelish, Elif dhe Emel.

programme.title: Lajme
programme.desc: Lajme nga vendi dhe bota.

programme.title: Lule të vetmuara
programme.desc: Nje drame familjare dhe njerezore e disa vajzave jetime, te cilat do te mesojne si te perballojne jeten krejtesisht te vetmuara, te dashurojne, te bejne gabime, te rrezohen, te poshterohen, te ringrihen dhe te mbijetojne duke u mbeshtetur tek njera-tjetra! Nje histori mbijetese e disa vajzave te reja, ne nje bote te madhe, ku ato jane thjesht ”Lule” te vetmuara!

programme.title: Të braktisurit
programme.desc: Kur jeta të merr gjithçka, mbetet vetëm forca për të luftuar. Një histori e jashtezakonshme për familjen, sakrificën dhe shpresën. Mes vështirësive dhe padrejtësive, ata kanë vetëm njëri-tjetrin. Një serial i mbushur me emocione të forta dhe momente të paharrueshme. Rrugëtimi emocionues i gjashtë fëmijëve jetimë që luftojnë për të mbetur bashkë në një botë që përpiqet t’i ndajë. Seriali qe ka prekur zemrat e miliona shikuesve dhe me i klikuari ne mediat sociale me disa aktore yje.

programme.title: Tradhtia
programme.desc: Ajo besoi tek dashuria dhe tek familja. Besoi se pas 30 vitesh martesë, e njihte njeriun që kishte në krah. Gyzide ka ndërtuar jetën e saj mbi drejtësinë. Por tani, drejtësinë do ta kërkojë brenda familjes së saj. Kur e vërteta del në dritë, asgjë nuk do të jetë më si më parë. A mund ta rindërtosh jetën pasi zbulon se gjithçka që besoje ishte një gënjeshtër? Vahide Perçin në një nga rolet më të fuqishme të karrierës së saj.

programme.title: Karteli
programme.desc: Vellezerit qe krijuan perandorine me te madhe te krimit te organizuar ne Cali gjate viteve ’60 - ’70. Familja, romancat dhe ambicja e dy vellezerve per te mbreteruar industrine e droges ne Kolumbi. Vellezerit Villegas, te njohur ndryshe si ”Los Caballeros de Cali”, kriminelet me te kerkuar ne te gjithe boten... Historia e vertete se si ata u bene nga femije te varfer, ne boset e droges. Bazuar ne librin ”El cartel de los sapos” te Andres Lopez.

programme.title: Rudina
programme.desc: Një show argëtues dhe informativ nga Rudina Magjistari, që e shoqeron çdo pasdite familjet shqiptare me të ftuar të shumtë e VIP, por dhe njerez të e thjeshte me historitë e tyre personale.

programme.title: Mashtruesit
programme.desc: Një dramë e mbushur me intriga, sekrete, dhe lojëra të rrezikshme, ku e vërteta dhe gënjeshtra ndërthuren në çdo hap. Ertan, një avokat i talentuar i cili së bashku me të atin, nuk heziton të përdorë metoda të pazakonta për të fituar çështjet e tyre dhe Asja, një grua që përballet me vështirësi të mëdha dhe detyrohet të përdorë zgjuarsinë dhe mashtrimin për të mbajtur familjen e saj. Sa më shumë zbulohen sekretet, aq më shumë bëhet e vështirë të dallosh se kush është viktimë, kush është mashtrue.

programme.title: Lajme
programme.desc: Lajme nga vendi dhe bota.

programme.title: STOP
programme.desc: Aktualiteti shqiptar ”alla Stop”, problematika e njerëzve të thjeshtë, që pasi kanë trokitur në të gjitha dyert, gjejnë zgjidhje vetëm në ”Stop” , video-kamera të fshehta, që denoncojnë e demaskojnë korrupsionin, dhunën apo abuzimin seksual. Akte humanizmi për më të pamundurit e fatkeqët, të cilëve u ndryshon jeta. Nje emision i gjithi vetëm për njerëzit e zakonshëm dhe me njerëzit në qendër.

programme.title: Opinion
programme.desc: Emisioni politik më i ndjekur dhe më i preferuar në ekranet shqiptare nga Blendi Fevziu. Arena e politikës shqiptare që prej 31 gushtit 1997. Komente, analiza, debate, personazhe, dëshmi dhe fakte konkrete. Ngjarjet më të fundit dhe më të rëndësishme.

programme.title: Ftesë në Pesë
programme.desc: Programi i pasdites në Top Channel, është një program sa informues aq edhe argëtues që ndërthur intervista, aktualitet, histori njerëzore dhe tema që prekin jetën e përditshme. Me të ftuar nga fusha të ndryshme, personazhe publike dhe njerëz me histori frymëzuese, programi sjell biseda të sinqerta, emocione, debat dhe këndvështrime të ndryshme mbi çështje sociale, kulturore dhe të aktualitetit, në një atmosferë të ngrohtë dhe komunikim të drejtpërdrejtë me publikun.

programme.title: Per’Puthen
programme.desc: Eshtë një program që vendos në qendër njohjet, flirtin dhe marrëdhëniet mes të rinjve që kërkojnë dashurinë. Djem dhe vajza, që njihen me njëri- tjetrin në ekran, për të përmbushur qëllimin e nje dashurie, të ndërtuar në sytë e publikut. Takimet, pëlqimet, xhelozitë, rivalitetet dhe debatet krijojnë dinamika të papritura, ndërsa historitë e personazheve zhvillohen natyrshëm përpara publikut.

programme.desc: Lajmet kryesore të ditës nga vendi dhe bota.

programme.title: Fiks fare
programme.desc: Programi i pare investigativ ne median shqiptare fokusuar ne korrupsionin e padrejtesite, trafikimin e abuzimet me pushtetin, problemet ekonomike, sociale si dhe hallet e ndryshme te njerezve. Fiks Fare trajton problematikat e qytetarëve, denoncon abuzimet, korrupsionin dhe shkeljet institucionale, duke i sjellë ato në vëmendjen e publikut dhe autoriteteve.

programme.title: Engjëjt e Çarlit 2
programme.desc: Treshja e mrekullueshme Cameron Diaz, Drew Barrymore dhe Lucy Liu rikthehet! Mjeshtret edhe kesaj radhe do te jene armike te betuara te krimit e padrejtesise.

programme.title: Tech Talk
programme.desc: Një format televiziv, radiofonik dhe digjital që e sjell teknologjinë pranë njerëzve: nga inteligjenca artificiale dhe startup-et, te siguria online, puna, familja, argëtimi dhe mënyra se si do të jetojmë nesër. TECH TALK programi qe flet per teknologjine dhe e kthen ate nga një temë shpesh teknike në një bisedë të qartë, të afërt dhe relevante për publikun e gjerë.

programme.title: Shqipëria Live
programme.desc: Programi ku perfshihen te gjitha tematikat kryesore te momentit. Te ftuar te ndryshem, intervista ekskluzive, lidhje direkte dhe debat ne studio. Nje mbulim 360 grade i ngjarjeve ne kohe reale, gjithcka qe ndodh ne vendin tone. Nje nga shtyllat kryesore te programit eshte larmishmeria e perfshirjes te figurave te ndryshme qofte ne studio por edhe nga terreni. Nje program i përditshëm informativ dhe i aktualitetit, i cili sjell në qendër të vëmendjes ngjarjet më të rëndësishme të ditës.

programme.title: Wake Up
programme.desc: Emisioni sjell një kombinim të lajmeve më të rëndësishme të ditës, analizave të aktualitetit, parashikimit të motit, informacioneve praktike, intervistave me të ftuar nga fusha të ndryshme, rubrikave të argëtimit dhe muzikës. Me një atmosferë dinamike dhe pozitive, synon t’i informojë dhe argëtojë teleshikuesit, duke u ofruar energjinë e duhur për nisjen e ditës.

programme.title: Në shtëpinë tonë
programme.desc: Në Shtëpinë Tonë” është emisioni i paradites në Top Channel, një hapësirë e ngrohtë ku bashkohen historia, emocionet, informacioni dhe argëtimi. Me personazhe të njohur e të zakonshëm, rrëfime që frymëzojnë, tema që prekin jetën familjare dhe këshilla praktike për përditshmërinë, programi bëhet pjesë e shtëpisë së çdo teleshikuesi. Në kuzhinë, receta të shijshme dhe ide të thjeshta gatimi sjellin çdo ditë shije dhe kreativitet.

programme.title: Champions League: Studio Champions
programme.desc: Ndeshjet e mëdha të Champions League do të shoqërohen nga një emision informativ ku do të analizohen ekipet më të mira dhe kompeticioni më i bukur në botë. Edi Manushi në moderim bashkë me ish-futbollistë dhe opinionistë do të sjellin çdo natë të Champions League analizën sportive para dhe pas ndeshjes. Pjesa e parë do të analizojë formacionet e skuadrave. Në pjesën e dytë pas ndeshjes do të komentojme rezultatin, paraqitjen e ekipeve si dhe do të shohim të gjithë golat.

programme.title: Inter-Stuttgart
programme.desc: Liga e Kampionëve është kompeticioni kryesor vjetor i UEFA-s për klubet e futbollit, që bashkon ekipet më të mira nga ligat kombëtare të Evropës. E themeluar në vitin 1955 si Kupa e Klubeve Kampione të Evropës dhe e riemërtuar në vitin 1992, ajo ka evoluar nga një turne me eliminim të drejtpërdrejtë në një fazë lige me 36 skuadra, të pasuar nga raunde me eliminim të drejtpërdrejtë dhe një finale me një ndeshje të vetme. Kualifikimi bazohet kryesisht në paraqitjen në ligat kombëtare dhe në koeficientët e federatave anëtare të UEFA-s, ndërsa kompeticioni përfaqëson nivelin më të lartë të futbollit evropian për klube. Fituesi shpallet kampion i Evropës për klube dhe kualifikohet gjithashtu për kompeticione të tjera të rëndësishme të UEFA-s dhe FIFA-s.

programme.title: Champions League: Studio Champions

Das Motto "Hefeteig" baut er zweifach in sein Menu ein: als Hefeteigschäleli für eine Suppe und als Hefeteigmantel um Kalbsteaks. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Mini Chuchi, dini Chuchi
programme.desc: Özlem aus Gossau SG kocht zur Wochenmitte ein Gericht mit "Hefeteig". Die 28-Jährige war früher selber leidenschaftliche Fussballspielerin und fiebert heute vor allem vor dem Fernseher und im Stadion mit. Sie kocht eine Spezialität aus der Türkei: Es gibt zweierlei Pide. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Meteo
programme.desc: In der Sendung "Meteo" wird das Publikum hinsichtlich der aktuellen Wetterlage informiert und Prognosen zeigen, mit welchen Entwicklungen man in den nächsten Tagen rechnen darf. In Zeiten, in denen das Wetter immer häufiger verrückt spielt, ist es gut, die Prognosen aufmerksam zu verfolgen, um im Falle einer aufziehenden Schlechtwetterfront rechtzeitig gewarnt zu sein. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: So schmeckt die Schweiz
programme.desc: Im Sommer leben Erika Tanner und ihr Partner Pascal Poltera mit ihren Tieren auf der Alp Flix. Sie besitzen Fleisch- und Milchgeissen. Dank der Alpkräuter stellen sie einen schmackhaften Feta her, den sie mit Gurken und Tomaten als griechischen Salat zum grillierten Gitzifleisch servieren. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: SRF bi de Lüt

programme.title: Grey's Anatomy – Die jungen Ärzte
programme.desc: Schwer verletzt wird „Das namenlose Mädchen“ ins Seattle Grace gebracht. Derek (Patrick Dempsey) und Meredith (Ellen Pompeo) finden heraus, dass viele Verletzungen schon alt sind. Anscheinend handelt es sich um Holly, ein Kind, das mit sechs Jahren auf einem Parkplatz entführt wurde. Was hat sie Schreckliches erlebt?

programme.title: Grey's Anatomy – Die jungen Ärzte
programme.desc: Cristina (Sandra Oh) reist gemeinsam mit Alex, Meredith, Jackson und April nach San Francisco. Kleine wie große Dramen überschatten ihren strapaziösen Prüfungsmarathon: Meredith leidet an einer üblen Magengrippe. April und Jackson hatten am Vorabend Sex, was April in einen schweren Gewissenskonflikt stürzt. Alex sorgt sich um Morgan, deren Baby im Sterben liegt.

programme.title: Gilmore Girls
programme.desc: Der Übergang auf die Privatschule läuft nicht ganz so gut, wie Rory es sich vorgestellt hatte. Weil sie kaum mit dem Stoff hinterherkommt, schreibt sie eine Vier in einem Test. Lorelai (Lauren Graham) lernt Rorys attraktiven Lehrer Max (Scott Cohen) auf einem Elternabend kennen und erfährt, dass Rory Schwierigkeiten in der Schule hat.

programme.title: Gilmore Girls
programme.desc: Zwischen Lorelai und Rorys Lehrer Max knistert es gewaltig. Während Lorelai sich aber zurückhält, um Rory vor Komplikationen zu bewahren, lädt Max das Gilmore Girl ein. Und wenn sie partout kein Abendessen will, dann wenigstens zu einem Kaffee.\n\nDerweil herrscht „Katzenjammer“ in Stars Hollow, weil Cinnamon, der Kater von Babette und Morey, gestorben ist. Während der Totenwache für das Tier ersc

programme.title: Gilmore Girls
programme.desc: Schlechtes Timing: Rorys (Alexis Bledel) Geburtstag fällt genau auf den Tag, an dem das wöchentliche Abendessen mit den Großeltern stattfindet. Wider Willen müssen Rory und Lorelai nach Hartford. Dort wartet eine unerwünschte Überraschung auf sie, denn Emily hat sämtliche Mitschülerinnen und Mitschüler von Chilton eingeladen, die Rory das Leben schwer machen...

programme.title: Gilmore Girls
programme.desc: Mit einem Päckchen Stärke in der Hand flieht Rory aus Taylors Lebensmittelgeschäft, nachdem sie von ihrem Schwarm Dean geküsst wurde. Solche Geschehnisse machen in Stars Hollow schnell die Runde: bald weiß die ganze Stadt Bescheid. Doch Rory bringt es nicht über sich, ihrer Mutter von ihrem ersten Kuss zu erzählen...

programme.title: Grey's Anatomy – Die jungen Ärzte
programme.desc: Nicht allein die mündlichen Prüfungen zehren an den Nerven der jungen Ärzte: Jackson (Jesse Williams) ist geschockt, weil er seine Mutter mit Dr. Webber in flagranti ertappt hat. Meredith plagt noch immer heftige Übelkeit. Indes muss sich Alex, der die erste Runde versäumt hat, nun doppelt anstrengen, um überhaupt noch eine Chance zu haben.

programme.title: Grey's Anatomy – Die jungen Ärzte
programme.desc: Schönheitschirurg Mark Sloan liegt im Koma. Als „Der 30. Tag“ anbricht, sollen die lebensverlängernden Maßnahmen eingestellt werden. Indes versetzt Meredith Grey (Ellen Pompeo) als Stationsärztin die Anfänger in Angst und Schrecken….

programme.title: Desperate Housewives
programme.desc: „Der Sinn des Lebens“. Susans (Teri Hatcher) Nieren drohen schlappzumachen. Bree zettelt deshalb eine Testaktion an, um einen Organspender zu finden. Das Ergebnis ringt ihr eine schwere Entscheidung ab. \n\nGerüchte gab’s lange, nun ist klar: Nach der nächsten Staffel ist Schluss. Schade!

programme.title: Desperate Housewives
programme.desc: Besonders Susan, die von Beths Nierenspende erfährt. Doch Ehemann Paul (Mark Moses) steht der geplanten Transplantation im Weg. Er will die Herz-Lungen-Maschine erst abschalten lassen, wenn Beths Mutter ihm den Grund für den Selbstmord nennt. \r\nRenee weigert sich indes, ihre geplante Party zu verschieben. Warum ist sie so herzlos? Gabrielle findet es heraus.

programme.title: Desperate Housewives
programme.desc: Andrew hatte einst Carlos’ Mutter überfahren – und es vertuscht. Jetzt will er im Rahmen eines Programms der Anonymen Alkoholiker seine Schuld gestehen. \r\nTom (Doug Savant) erhält einen Bonus seiner neuen Firma. Doch Lynette (Felicity Huffman) muss erkennen, dass Toms Job auch Nachteile hat.

programme.title: Desperate Housewives
programme.desc: Trotz Carlos’ Verbot trifft sich Gabrielle weiterhin mit Bree – heimlich. Als Carlos Indizien für ihr Beisammensein findet, stellt er sie vor die Wahl: Bree oder er? \n\nSusan leidet währenddessen an Sexträumen, in denen ausgerechnet Paul die Hauptrolle spielt. Lynette (Felicity Huffman) begleitet Tom zu einer Konferenz – und verursacht nichts als Ärger.

programme.title: Grey's Anatomy – Die jungen Ärzte

Meredith plagt noch immer heftige Übelkeit. Indes muss sich Alex, der die erste Runde versäumt hat, nun doppelt anstrengen, um überhaupt noch eine Chance zu haben.

programme.title: Grey's Anatomy – Die jungen Ärzte
programme.desc: Schönheitschirurg Mark Sloan liegt im Koma. Als „Der 30. Tag“ anbricht, sollen die lebensverlängernden Maßnahmen eingestellt werden. Indes versetzt Meredith Grey (Ellen Pompeo) als Stationsärztin die Anfänger in Angst und Schrecken….

programme.title: Gilmore Girls
programme.desc: Schlechtes Timing: Rorys (Alexis Bledel) Geburtstag fällt genau auf den Tag, an dem das wöchentliche Abendessen mit den Großeltern stattfindet. Wider Willen müssen Rory und Lorelai nach Hartford. Dort wartet eine unerwünschte Überraschung auf sie, denn Emily hat sämtliche Mitschülerinnen und Mitschüler von Chilton eingeladen, die Rory das Leben schwer machen...

programme.title: Gilmore Girls
programme.desc: Mit einem Päckchen Stärke in der Hand flieht Rory aus Taylors Lebensmittelgeschäft, nachdem sie von ihrem Schwarm Dean geküsst wurde. Solche Geschehnisse machen in Stars Hollow schnell die Runde: bald weiß die ganze Stadt Bescheid. Doch Rory bringt es nicht über sich, ihrer Mutter von ihrem ersten Kuss zu erzählen...

programme.title: Gilmore Girls

programme.title: Desperate Housewives

Doch Lynette (Felicity Huffman) muss erkennen, dass Toms Job auch Nachteile hat.

programme.title: Desperate Housewives

Als Carlos Indizien für ihr Beisammensein findet, stellt er sie vor die Wahl: Bree oder er? \n\nSusan leidet währenddessen an Sexträumen, in denen ausgerechnet Paul die Hauptrolle spielt. Lynette (Felicity Huffman) begleitet Tom zu einer Konferenz – und verursacht nichts als Ärger.

programme.title: Desperate Housewives
programme.desc: Tom beauftragt seine Ehefrau Lynette (Felicity Huffman) und ihre Freundin Renee (Vanessa Williams), sein Büro einzurichten. Doch nur eine der beiden Ladys hält sich an seine Wünsche… \n\nDerweil versucht Bree, Gabys frechen Töchtern Manieren beizubringen.

programme.title: Dr. House

programme.title: Dr. House

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: Ein Bekannter von Joans Schwester bittet die Detektive um Hilfe, denn seine Internet-Freundin Maria ist wie vom Erdboden verschluckt. Wurde sie entführt? Bei den Ermittlungen stellen Joan und Sherlock fest, dass Maria ihren Lebensunterhalt damit verdient hat, dass sie sich von Online-Verehrern mit Gutscheinen überhäufen ließ. Hatte einer ihrer Verehrer genug von der Vereinbarung?
